items.en: Russia develops jet-powered versions of the Garpiya strike drone; NTV footage also shows a KamAZ-based mobile launcher
items.nl: Rusland ontwikkelt straalaangedreven versies van de Garpiya-aanvalsdrone; NTV-beelden tonen ook een mobiele lanceerinrichting op KamAZ-chassis
items.sEn: Russia has developed a jet-powered version of the Garpiya strike drone, Militarnyi reports, based on a report by Russian state broadcaster NTV that was highlighted by the Telegram channel Colonel GSh. The footage shows two jet variants. One is a transitional version that puts a jet engine in the existing piston-engine…

Het baseert zich op een reportage van de Russische staatszender NTV die werd uitgelicht door het Telegramkanaal Colonel GSh. De beelden tonen twee straalvarianten. items.en: Russia upgrades the Geran-4 jet drone with a shaped-charge cutting warhead and 'whisker' contact fuze against power lines and bridges; HUR details a US-made magnetometer, 'Susanin' optical navigation and an Alabuga-built engine

items.sEn: Speaking at the Cultural Forum, Vladimir Putin claimed Ukraine was seeking an 'air ceasefire' because it cannot cope with Russia's new jet-powered Geran drones: 'At least for now, they have no way to counter them — no antidote.' items.en: Ukraine Intercepts 55% of russia's Jet-Powered Shahed Drones as New Countermeasures Enter Combat
items.nl: Oekraïne onderschept 55% van Ruslands straalaangedreven Shahed-drones nu nieuwe tegenmaatregelen in gevecht worden ingezet
items.sEn: According to Defense Express, Russia launched more than 2,730 jet-powered Shahed-type drones against Ukraine in September alone. items.en: Ракета или дрон: в польской прессе оценили «Герань-5»
items.nl: Raket of drone: Poolse pers beoordeelt de 'Geran-5'

items.en: Russia strikes Kyiv in overnight, daytime and evening drone waves on 25 September; 173 drones, over 50 of them jet-powered, launched the following night
items.nl: Rusland valt Kyiv op 25 september aan met dronegolven 's nachts, overdag en 's avonds; de nacht erna volgen 173 drones, waarvan ruim 50 met straalmotor
items.sEn: Russia struck Kyiv in several separate drone waves on 25 September rather than in a single night-time raid.
